params.body:
The monitor reported "Curation proposals are piling up: 223 waiting for a human", while the curation queue (`listShowcasePending`, now also the `curate_queue` tool) held none.

Cause: the monitor counted every insight with `showcase_status = 'proposed'`, including trends folded into another since then (`superseded_by` set). Most likely these date from the twin fold of 23 September 2026, when 144 trends turned out to be 48 ideas. A proposal on a folded trend waits for nobody, and the queue already leaves those out.

The monitor now counts what the queue shows: `superseded_by IS NULL`. The false alarm goes, and a real backlog still raises it at the same threshold.

Tests: `test/monitor*.test.mjs` passes 35 of 35. `assess` takes the count as input, so its cases are unchanged.

params.title: The monitor counts the proposals the queue shows, not those on folded trends
